question: Chapter 3 found that, at matched average exposure, an amplification-based limit does not beat a volatility limit over all hours. Does the summed-response guard, or the amplification-adjusted volatility limit, beat a plain volatility limit in stress hours, where worst-case loss matters?
freshness: No 2025-2026 file of the repository that mentions these symbols uses the 8th, 29th or 31st of a month, except 2026-07-08 and 2026-04-29, which are excluded.
data: data.binance.vision USD-M daily klines (1m), bookDepth and metrics; Binance .CHECKSUM verified; a symbol-day is valid with validated depth on at least 80% of minutes (Chapter 3 rule)

rules.amp_vol: R = rv_360 * gain_multiple^theta, theta in {0, .25, .5, .75, 1} chosen by minimum training TLR

sizing: q = c_s / R with c_s making the training mean of q equal to 1 for each symbol and rule; risk winsorized at pooled training 1%/99%; loss = q * MAE_60; TLR = ES95(loss)/mean(q)
stress: test hours with rv_360 >= the symbol's training 90th percentile of rv_360
primary_1: G1: log TLR(amp_vol) - log TLR(vol) over stress hours has a 95% date-block bootstrap interval (2,000 draws, seed 20261103) below zero and a Holm-adjusted one-sided p (share of draws >= 0) below 0.05
primary_2: G2: the same for the guard
correction: Holm across G1 and G2 at 0.05
secondary: the same comparisons over all test hours (replication of Chapter 3)
prior_information: Over all hours, Chapter 3 found that a six-hour estimate adds nothing to volatility in sizing, and a three-day certified estimate improves a volatility limit only modestly. A pass here would locate the guard's value in stress hours; a fail would mean the guard's theoretical advantage does not translate into realized tail losses even there.
opening_rule: Specification, hash and counter at 0 are pushed in a commit of their own before any test data are downloaded; the pipeline refuses to run unless the committed specification matches and the counter is 0; it sets the counter to 1 and evaluates once. Results, numbers, counter and download log are committed together.
